summary: PASSporT is a signed token that conveys information about a phone call. This RFC extends it to carry rich call data about the call and the caller, such as a description, that can be signed and protected, sent along, and shown to the person receiving the call.

eli5.summary: When a call comes in, your phone could show who it is and why, and you can trust it wasn't faked. This adds a signed "caller card" to the call.

questions: how to sign caller information in shaken
